Fingerprint and face lock.

blocks.text: 3. NaraaCare is a health-tracking app, not a medical app

spans.t: In short: NaraaCare is a health-tracking app that helps you track water, food and sleep. It is not a medical app and does not diagnose or treat any condition. For any health decision, please check with your doctor.

3.1 NaraaCare is a health-tracking app (general wellness software). It helps healthy adults keep track of everyday habits: hydration, nutrition and sleep. It shows these as avatars, goals, streaks and reports, and lets you share progress with people you choose.
3.2 NaraaCare is
not
a medical device, or software intended to diagnose, treat, cure, monitor or prevent any disease or condition;
a substitute for advice from a doctor, dietitian or other qualified professional;
a telemedicine or emergency service. We do not connect you to doctors.
3.3 Goals, targets, scores and estimates in the app (for example, daily water need, calorie and nutrient targets, sleep score and avatar levels) are
estimates for healthy adults
. They come from published formulas and our own product choices, and they depend on the information you enter. They can be wrong for you.
In short: listen to your body and your doctor first. If something feels wrong, stop and get medical help. In an emergency, call 112.
Please check with your doctor first

before changing how much you eat, drink, sleep or exercise, especially if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have a kidney, heart, liver or metabolic condition, have or have had an eating disorder, take medicines that affect fluids or appetite, or are recovering from illness or surgery. The app's estimates are not designed for these situations. If you tell us during onboarding that you have a medical condition, we will remind you to check with your doctor; we do not change your goals or Rin's replies based on any condition.
Use your own judgement.
Do not ignore professional advice, or delay seeking it, because of anything in the app. Stop any activity, and seek help, if you feel unwell, dizzy, faint, short of breath or in pain.
Safety limits are built in, but they are not a guarantee.

For example, we keep daily calorie targets above a minimum floor, keep daily water targets between set lower and upper limits, and restrict weight-loss goals for users in a lower BMI range. These limits are general safeguards, not personal medical limits. Drinking far more water than your body needs can be harmful; follow the app's warnings and your doctor's advice.
Food and drink data are approximate.

Nutrition values, portion sizes (such as a katori or a piece), barcode results and AI estimates for custom drinks may differ from what you actually consume. Check labels where you can, especially if you have an allergy or a dietary restriction. Do not rely on the app to identify allergens.
Emergencies.
NaraaCare cannot respond to emergencies. If you or someone else is in danger, call
(national emergency number) or
(ambulance), or go to the nearest hospital.
Eating concerns.

NaraaCare is not designed to support very low food intake or rapid weight loss. If you are worried about your eating, your weight or your relationship with food, please talk to a doctor. You can also call Tele-MANAS, the Government of India's free mental health helpline, on
Reminders.
Hydration, nutrition and sleep reminders depend on your phone's settings and may not always arrive on time. Do not rely on NaraaCare to remind you to take medicines or for any medical task.

In short: Rin is an AI wellness assistant, not a health advisor. It uses only the data you log in your avatars. It can be helpful, but it can also be wrong, and it is not a doctor. For health decisions, please check with your doctor. You control whether Rin can use your data.
What Rin does.

Rin is an AI wellness assistant available on the STAR plan. It is not a doctor, dietitian or health advisor. Rin uses only the data you log in your Hydration, Nutrition and Sleep avatars to answer general questions about hydration, food, nutrition and sleep; estimate the water content of custom drinks; help you log meals and drinks by chat; and create insights for STAR reports. Rin's replies are generated automatically by artificial intelligence. No human reviews them before you see them.
Rin can make mistakes.

AI output can be inaccurate, incomplete or out of date, and may sound more certain than it is. Rin does not diagnose, prescribe or give medical advice; for any health question, please check with your doctor. Always check meal and drink entries that Rin suggests before you add them to your avatar. Do not use Rin for symptoms, medicines or emergencies; see Section 4.
Consent and your data.

Rin works only after you give separate consent for AI processing. Rin uses only your avatar data: the drinks, meals, sleep and workouts you log, the goals and progress shown in your avatars, and the messages you send Rin. Rin does not use your name, email address, phone number, your onboarding details (including any medical condition), or any data that other Care Circle members have shared with you. We send the avatar data needed for each reply to our AI provider. Our current provider processes this data outside India, and has told us that data sent through its business API is not used to train its models. You can withdraw AI consent at any time in Settings; Rin will then stop working for you and stop using your data. Our Privacy Policy has the details.
Usage allowance.

Each STAR account has a monthly Rin usage allowance, shown in the app as a percentage bar. When it runs out, Rin pauses until the allowance resets, as shown in the app. We may change the allowance with notice. If our AI provider is unavailable, a simpler built-in version of Rin may answer instead, using only your own logged data.
Your responsibilities.

Do not use Rin to create content that is unlawful, harmful, misleading or that impersonates a real person, or to try to make it break its safety rules. Unlawful use of AI-generated content can lead to civil and criminal liability under Indian law, removal of the content, and suspension or termination of your account (see Sections 9 and 13). If you share Rin's output outside the app, make clear that it was generated by AI.
Conversations.

Your Rin conversations are stored with your account so you can search them and so Rin can respond with context. You can delete them at any time, and Rin will then no longer use them. They are also deleted with your account.

spans.t: Price and taxes.

The price you pay is the one shown on the Google Play or App Store checkout screen when you buy, including applicable taxes such as GST. If we change the price of STAR, the new price applies only from your next renewal after we, or the store, give you notice. You can cancel before then.
Buying through the app stores.

STAR is sold only as an in-app purchase through Google Play Billing (Android) or Apple In-App Purchase (iOS). The store processes your payment, so we never see or store your card, UPI or bank details. Your purchase is also subject to the store's own terms.
Automatic renewal.

Your STAR subscription renews automatically at the end of each monthly or yearly period, and the store charges your chosen payment method, unless you cancel before the renewal date. The renewal date is shown in Settings → My Subscriptions and in your store account.
How to cancel.
You can cancel any time in a few taps:
Android:
Google Play app → Profile → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → NaraaCare → Cancel.
iPhone:
Settings → your name → Subscriptions → NaraaCare → Cancel Subscription.
We link to these screens from Settings → My Subscriptions. Deleting the app, or your NaraaCare account, does not cancel the store subscription on its own.
After you cancel.

You keep STAR until the end of the period you have paid for. Your account then moves to Standard. Data you created on STAR (such as sleep history and AI report insights) stays in your account and appears in reports for the period when you were on STAR. You get full access back if you subscribe again. If you shared your Sleep avatar in a Care Circle, other members will no longer see it.
Refunds.

Because the app stores take the payment, refund requests are handled by Google Play or Apple under their refund policies. If you are unable to get help from the store, contact us at support@naraacare.com and we will help where we can. Nothing in these Terms limits any refund right you have under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
Invoices.
The app store issues receipts for your purchases. You can see your plan history in Settings → My Subscriptions.
Free trials and offers.

If we offer a free trial, introductory price or promotion, we will show its terms clearly before you sign up, including when paid billing starts and how to cancel before then. Promo codes cannot be exchanged for cash, cannot be combined unless we say so, and may expire or be withdrawn if misused.
Failed payments.
If the app store cannot collect a renewal payment, it may retry for a short period. If payment still fails, your account moves to Standard until payment succeeds.
Pricing errors.

If a price is shown wrongly because of an obvious error, we may correct it. If you have already been charged the wrong price, we will tell you and help you get a refund of any overcharge through the app store, or offer you the option to cancel.
In short: you decide what you share and with whom. What you share in a circle is visible to its members. Be kind, and respect other people's privacy.
What you share.

When you create or join a Care Circle, you choose which avatars (Hydration, Nutrition and, on STAR, Sleep) to share. Members of that circle can see your username, profile avatar, the avatars you shared (a shared Sleep avatar is visible only to members on STAR) and updates to them, and the messages you post. You can change what you share, or leave a circle, at any time. Once you stop sharing, members no longer see that avatar, but they may already have seen earlier updates.
Circles.

A circle can have up to 50 members, and you can join as many circles as you like. The person who creates a circle is its admin and can invite, manage and remove members, and change the circle's name and wallpaper. Invite links let people outside NaraaCare join after signing up; share them only with people you trust.
Connections.
You can find people by username, send and accept connection requests, and block anyone. Blocked users cannot contact you or add you to circles.
Other people's information.
Only share information about yourself. Do not post, screenshot or forward another member's health information outside the circle without their permission.
Our role.

Messages and updates in circles are posted by users, not by us. We act as an intermediary under the Information Technology Act, 2000 for this content. We do not pre-screen it, but we act on complaints and on what we become aware of, as described in Sections 9 and 18. You can report a message or a user from inside the app or by writing to our Grievance Officer.
In short: your data and posts belong to you. You give us permission to use them only to run NaraaCare for you. We do not sell your health data.
You own your content.
"Your content" means the information you enter or post: profile and onboarding details, food, water, sleep and workout logs, messages, Rin conversations and feedback.
Permission you give us.

You give us a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide permission to host, store, copy, process, display and transmit your content, only as needed to provide, secure and improve the Service and as described in our Privacy Policy. This includes showing your shared content to the circle members you choose. This permission ends when your content is deleted, except for copies we must keep by law (see Section 13.4).
No sale of health data.

We do not sell your personal data or health data, and we do not use it for third-party advertising. We may use aggregated, de-identified statistics that cannot reasonably identify you to understand and improve the Service.
Feedback.
If you send us ideas or suggestions, we may use them without any obligation to you.
Intellectual property complaints.

If you believe content on NaraaCare infringes your copyright or trademark, write to our Grievance Officer (Section 18). Include your contact details, a description of the work, where the content appears in the app, and a statement that you own the rights or are authorised to act for the owner. We will act on valid complaints as required by the Copyright Act, 1957 and the Information Technology Act, 2000.
In short: use NaraaCare lawfully and kindly. Don't post harmful content, don't harass anyone, and don't try to break or misuse the app.
Content you must not post or share.

As required by the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, you must not host, display, upload, publish, transmit, store or share any information that:
1. belongs to another person and you have no right to share;

2. is obscene, pornographic or paedophilic, invades another person's privacy (including bodily privacy), insults or harasses on the basis of gender, is racially or ethnically objectionable, relates to or encourages money laundering or gambling, or promotes enmity between groups on grounds of religion or caste with intent to incite violence;
3. is harmful to children;
4. infringes any patent, trademark, copyright or other proprietary right;
5. deceives or misleads about where a message came from, or knowingly and intentionally communicates misinformation or information that is patently false and untrue or misleading;
6. impersonates another person;

7. threatens the unity, integrity, defence, security or sovereignty of India, friendly relations with foreign States, or public order, incites any cognisable offence, prevents the investigation of any offence, or insults another nation;
8. contains software viruses or any other code designed to interrupt, destroy or limit the functioning of any computer resource;
9. violates any law in force in India.
Health-specific rules.
On NaraaCare you also must not:
promote or encourage eating disorders, extreme dieting, self-harm or suicide;
offer medical diagnosis, prescriptions or unproven "cures", or sell or promote medicines, supplements or other products;
shame, bully or harass anyone about their body, weight, food or health;
post another person's health information without their permission.
Misuse of the Service.

You must not: copy, scrape or harvest data from the Service; reverse engineer, decompile or tamper with the app, except where the law allows it; bypass security, rate limits, usage allowances or plan restrictions; use bots or automated access; interfere with our servers; create accounts by automated means or under false identities; or use the Service to send spam.
What happens if you break these rules.

We may, depending on how serious the breach is: remove or disable access to the content; warn you; suspend your access to some or all features; or terminate your account. Where we are required by law, we will preserve evidence and report offences (for example, under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 or the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012) to the appropriate authorities. Where the law requires, we may also share information about the account responsible with the authorities, or with a person who has complained about unlawful content concerning them. Posting unlawful content may also make you liable to penalties or punishment under the Information Technology Act, 2000, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 or other laws.
Reminder.
As required by law, we will remind you of these rules, our Privacy Policy and these Terms at least once every three months, in the app or by email.
In short: our Privacy Policy explains exactly what we collect and why. You can download your data, correct it, withdraw consent or delete your account at any time.
Privacy Policy.

How we collect, use, store and share personal data is set out in our Privacy Policy at naraacare.com/privacy, which forms part of these Terms. We process personal data in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the rules made under it, and the Information Technology Act, 2000.
Consent.

We ask for your consent before processing your health data, and separately before using it for Rin AI. We ask for permission before using your device's camera (barcode scanning), microphone (voice logging) or notifications. You can withdraw any consent in Settings or your device settings; features that depend on it will then stop working.
Your rights.

Subject to law, you can ask to access a summary of your personal data, correct or update it, erase it, nominate someone to exercise your rights if you die or become incapacitated, and raise a grievance. You can download a copy of your data from Settings at any time.
Where your data is stored.

Your account data is stored on servers in India. Some processing happens outside India, for example the data our AI provider processes to answer you in Rin (Section 5.3) and sign-in with Google or Apple. We transfer data outside India only as the law permits.
Security.

We use reasonable security safeguards, including encrypted connections, hashed passwords and access controls. No online service is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. If a personal data breach affects you, we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.
Messages from us.

We send service messages that are needed to run your account, such as sign-in codes, security alerts, subscription notices and changes to these Terms; these cannot be turned off while you have an account. Reminders, goal updates and Care Circle notifications can be turned off in Settings → Notifications & Reminders. We will send product news or offers only if you agree, and you can opt out at any time.

Your choice.
If you continue to use the Service after changes take effect, you accept the updated Terms. If you do not agree, stop using the Service, cancel your subscription and delete your account.

Talk to us first.

Your consumer rights are not affected.
